import copy
def sqA():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==4:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if min(rs)>=35 and min(rs)<=45 and min(cs)<25: return (min(rs),min(cs),n['color'])
    return None
print("start", sqA())
for click in [(41,17),(42,17),(42,18)]:
    r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':click[0],'col':click[1]}])
    a = previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); b = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    diffs=[(i,j,a[i][j],b[i][j]) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]!=b[i][j] and 10<=i<=62]
    print(click, "core diffs:", diffs, "sqA:", sqA())
    if any(d[2]!=d[3] and d[2] in 'MpY' and d[3] in 'MpY' for d in diffs):
        print("COLOR CHANGE!"); break
</parameter>
</function>
